messages.author: bdac8f1b7023ffbe
messages.subject: INLA installation fails
parts:
I am trying to install INLA on Windows.  I am using R version 4.3.3
While doing install.packages call taken from INLA download page, I keep getting an error.


> install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE) Installing package into ‘C:/Users/mbrabec/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.3’ (as ‘lib’ is unspecified) Warning in install.packages : dependencies ‘HKprocess’, ‘Rgraphviz’, ‘graph’ are not available There is a binary version available but the source version is later: binary source needs_compilation INLA 23.09.09 24.12.11 FALSE installing the source package ‘INLA’ trying URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/src/contrib/INLA_24.12.11.tar.gz' Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 63101058 bytes (60.2 MB) downloaded 60.2 MB * installing *binary* package 'INLA' ... cp: unknown option -- ) Try '/usr/bin/cp --help' for more information. ERROR: installing binary package failed * removing 'C:/Users/mbrabec/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.3/INLA' Warning in install.packages : installation of package ‘INLA’ had non-zero exit status The downloaded source packages are in ‘C:\Users\mbrabec\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpSgNCbX\downloaded_packages’

What to do next?

Thanks a lot for the help and All the Best
 Marek

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA installation fails
parts:
Please upgrade to R 4.4. And retry 

-- 
Håvard Rue 
hr...@r-inla.org
